podcast.body: A "super re-edition" coinciding with an anniversary, this release comes in an enormous box set format that is currently fashionable. It includes approximately four vinyl discs containing virtually all material from that era of the band. "coincidiendo con el aniversario sale en estas enormes cajas que están ahora tan de moda que juntan como cuatro discos de vinilo con todo lo que existe prácticamente de esta época de la banda."

This album contains the song "Get Down Make Love," which Nine Inch Nails covered at a concert in Toronto in 1990. "It was an insanely heavy version of the Queen song Get Down Make Love from their 1977 album News of the World."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This album, released in 1977, features the songs "We Will Rock You" and "We Are The Champions," which were released together as a double A-side single from the album. "From the news of the world album in 1977, we will rock you and we are the champions was released as a double A side single and therefore they are typically played together on the radio."
